what: Scilla, Nati 1892, atto 230 — born 6 October 1892, Via Grotte 75

correction: The register gives his parents as Francesco Antonio Arena, marinaro, and Serafina Arlotta. The tree gives Orazio Arena and Giovana Zirilli. Act 22 of 1893 adds a trade the tree does not record -- MARINARO, a sailor -- and that cuts AGAINST the archive's hypothesis rather than for it, since the Rocco Arena of act 228 is the son of Francesco Antonio Arena, also a marinaro. The act carries no age for him: it was declared by the midwife, not the father.

what: Scilla, Nati 1859, atto 46 — a son Domenico, born 10 February 1859
correction: The tree gives him no source at all. Act 46 of 1859 records him and Giovanna Zirilli as the parents of a son Domenico at Scilla — the first record of this couple the archive has found. It does not confirm Rocco Arena as their son.

what: Scilla, Nati 1859, atto 46 — named as the mother, with Orazio Arena
correction: The export carries her twice as Orazio Arena's wife: undated here, and as Giovanna Zirilli b. 1827 with a son Guiseppe. Act 46 shows a single couple at Scilla in 1859. The two records have NOT been merged, because surname endogamy at Scilla is common enough that a second wife of the same surname is a real possibility.
